headline: ICRA Trims India's FY27 GDP Forecast to 7.1% as Q2 Growth Moderates
summary: Credit rating agency ICRA trimmed its full-year FY27 economic growth outlook for India to 7.1%, estimating that second-quarter expansion eased to 7.5% due to slower services and agricultural output.
why: India is currently the fastest-growing major global economy; growth decelerations directly affect corporate earnings projections and Reserve Bank of India rate easing.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: A trimmed full-year GDP growth forecast points to moderation across industrial and agricultural production.
